html:
Trees use nested [value,left,right] lists; an empty subtree is None. Return the number of nodes on a longest root-to-leaf path. The empty tree has height 0.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      4,
      [
        2,
        [
          1,
          null,
          null
        ],
        null
      ],
      null
    ]
  ],
  "expected": 3
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    null
  ],
  "expected": 0
}
Hint

A node contributes one above its taller subtree.

Complexity: O(n) time, O(h) recursion space
